label_mapping_evidence.documentation_source: UCI ML Repository dataset 967: 'Label 1 corresponds to a legitimate URL, label 0 to a phishing URL'.
label_mapping_evidence.interpretation: Label 1 rows have a higher mean URLSimilarityIndex and more social/copyright markers, consistent with label 1 = legitimate.

shortcut_analysis.finding: Every legitimate URL in this file is an https://www.<host> address with no path, query or fragment, while phishing URLs vary. A URL-only model can therefore reach very high accuracy by learning this collection pattern, which may not hold for real legitimate URLs that contain paths.

excluded_columns_and_reason.FILENAME: identifier of the crawled page; may encode collection order
excluded_columns_and_reason.Title: webpage text, not available from a URL string
excluded_columns_and_reason.Domain: derived from URL; recomputed consistently by the shared extractor instead
excluded_columns_and_reason.TLD: derived from URL; recomputed by the shared extractor using the Public Suffix List
excluded_columns_and_reason.precomputed URL features (URLLength, NoO: stored values did not reproduce from the URL (e.g. URLLength equals len(URL) for only the share above)
excluded_columns_and_reason.URLSimilarityIndex, TLDLegitimateProb, U: need webpage content or dataset-wide reference tables
excluded_columns_and_reason.all HTML/JS/page columns (LineOfCode, Ha: require fetching the page, which this project never does
